Motion To Vacate
Off Calendar Sep-26-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Petitioner's Motion to Vacate the Dismissal of OSC for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Petitioner: Toya Beck, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for and with the Minor: Nathaniel Williams III, was sworn and examined.
After hearing the testimony and considering of documents filed, motion is granted and added to the calendar for hearing on Petition to Change Name of a Minor.
No objections to the proposed change of name of a minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Trey Louis Bennett McKnedy.
Decree signed in open court.

MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Jacqueline Chan.
Petitioner: Toya Back, was late and admonished, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Nathaniel Williams III, was sworn and examined.
Petitioner's request for an Order to Dispensing Notice is Denied without prejudice in open court.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to Aug. 3, 2006 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date.
